proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5812 *tinta wet explicitly gives Assamese/Bengali titā, Maithili tital/tītal wet and Hindi tītā. Simple tit/tital responses fit this family; vowel and l-inflection variation is retained and local transmission unresolved. Retroflex ṭiṭino and voiced-d extensions are not included here. Exact response: titə.
